issue_context.title: UCP: unexpected error happened when select dbName.viewName.col from another database
issue_context.body:
## Description

### 1. What did you do?
``` sql
use test;
create table t(a int);
use mysql;
create view v as select * from test.t;
use test;
select mysql.v.a from mysql.v;
```
<!-- If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see?
no error happens

### 3. What did you see instead?
`ERROR 1054 (42S22): Unknown column 'mysql.v.a' in 'field list'`
